Usage: less [options] [[file]]

Display file contents one screen at a time with scrolling, search, and ANSI colour passthrough.

Options:
  -N                           Show line numbers
  -S                           Chop (truncate) long lines instead of wrapping
  -F                           Quit if content fits on one screen (default: on)
  -R                           Raw ANSI passthrough (default: on)
  -X                           Don't clear screen on exit (default: on)
  -i                           Case-insensitive search (smart case: sensitive if pattern has uppercase)
  -I                           Force case-insensitive search
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Wildcards (Windows):
  On Windows, * and ? in path arguments are expanded by less itself
  (cmd and PowerShell don't expand them). [...] is matched literally and
  '**' is not supported. A pattern matching nothing is passed through
  unchanged. In cmd, quote the pattern to suppress expansion.

Examples:
  git diff | less           Page coloured diff output
  less logfile.txt          View a file with scrolling and search
  less -N logfile.txt       View with line numbers
  less -S wide.csv          View wide file with horizontal scrolling
  less +F logfile.txt       Follow file for new content (like tail -f)
  less +/error logfile.txt  Open file and jump to first 'error'

Exit Codes:
  0  Success
  1  Error (file not found, read error, permission denied)
  2  Usage error (POSIX-traditional; deliberate suite divergence since less replaces a POSIX tool)
